entities.summary: The Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary is a Catholic church and minor basilica within the Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes in France. Its main theme is a celebration and depiction of the Rosary. Rosary Basilica is a minor basilica in Europe, established in 1901. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
